scope: 人工冻结小宇宙、美国上市股票/ETF、日线输入、周/月决策、本地 long-only PaperAccount。

security_identity.symbol_rule: symbol is an alias with valid_from/valid_to; ticker changes never create a new economic identity by themselves
security_identity.universe_rule: each hypothesis freezes an as-of universe snapshot and inclusion rationale before any test

calendar_and_causality.calendar: explicit exchange session table with timezone; data-row intersection is never a calendar
calendar_and_causality.decision_bar_rule: a close-derived signal at session T is available only after that close
calendar_and_causality.earliest_default_fill: next eligible session T+1 using the preregistered fill-price model
calendar_and_causality.same_bar_fill: forbidden unless the signal was provably available before the chosen executable price and the alternate timing was preregistered
calendar_and_causality.missing_session_rule: report coverage and fail the run when required strategy/benchmark sessions differ; never hide via zip or intersection

price_and_cashflow.source_of_truth: raw prices plus separately stored split/dividend actions
price_and_cashflow.strategy_returns: account cash, positions, fills, fees and corporate-action cashflows
price_and_cashflow.benchmark_returns: total return including split and dividend cashflows under the same calendar and currency
price_and_cashflow.unresolved_action: run or account result is incomplete, not zero-filled

benchmark_policy.comparison_rule: strategy and benchmark use identical start/end eligible sessions and explicit coverage differences
benchmark_policy.reference_rule: golden fixtures are checked against an independently calculated reference sequence
benchmark_policy.claim_boundary: beating a benchmark in historical or paper data does not establish live investability

experiment_lineage.rule: parameter, symbol, cleaning, benchmark or presentation changes create descendants under the same root unless an independent adjudicator records a substantively new mechanism before seeing results
experiment_lineage.statistical_claim_rule: V1 records all trials, effective sample information, dependence assumptions and uncertainty; it does not emit strategy-edge pass/fail or probability-of-edge from historical data.
